versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes in this version.  
- Documentation, code, and outputs remain unchanged.

- Initial release of pindou-pattern skill: generate perler bead (拼豆) patterns from images or JSON.
- Outputs scalable/printable SVG pattern sheets, HTML previews, CSV color/materials list, and JSON grid.
- Built-in support for 205 official bead colors across 5 brands (MARD/COCO/漫漫/盼盼/咪小窝); uses only the Python standard library.
- Allows image inputs (PNG preferred, supports JPEG/WebP if Pillow installed), with advanced color quantization and color matching.
- Fully configurable grid size, color system, blanking logic, and output formats via command-line options.
- No external dependencies, no need for Node.js or third-party image libraries—ready to use out of the box.
